text:
sam: spotted a noisy config rollout in canary. ~5-7% 503 spike. thinking we should stop relying on 'apply failed' pages and classify applies by potential runtime impact. pinging @julia @anya for thoughts

julia: agree. we see too many pages for harmless console flips. can you paste the change and which route/quota it touched?

sam: console change to a routing flag + quota bump. diff:
```
- route_quota: 12000
+ route_quota: 24000
- enable_new_split_router: false
+ enable_new_split_router: true
```
changed cohort size from 1% -> 10% during canary.

anya: two separate concerns: persistence/apply errors (config didn't commit) vs runtime regressions caused by the new behavior. We should only page on persistent apply errors or when heuristic shows SLO impact.

matt: propose API-level fields on apply/create: `default_severity` (info|warn|page), `page_on_error_rate_above` (float), `page_on_slo_breach` (bool), `exposure_window_seconds` (int). Server computes a recommended severity at apply-time and emits telemetry. Console shows recommended + allows owner override with `override_reason`.

sam: who sets `default_severity`? owner or server?

julia: server-recommendation + owner opt-in override is safest. server can run quick preflight checks (simulated routing evaluation) and post-apply heuristics during the exposure window to upgrade severity if metrics breach thresholds.

ops-bot: config-apply report for rollout `roll-2026xyz` — 92 applies, 5.8% error rate observed, auto-rollback executed to snapshot `s-2026-03-01`.

anya: perfect bot output. let's make thresholds explicit in the schema (so console shows them): `error_rate_threshold_pct`, `min_tenant_impact_pct`, `exposure_window_seconds`. defaults in config CLI but visible in console.

matt: also include audit fields `computed_by` (system heuristic) and `computed_at` timestamp, plus `owner_override_by` and `owner_override_reason`. telemetry events `config.apply.start` `config.apply.end` should include `tenant_count`, `error_rate_pct`, `slo_breach` true/false.

sam: action items: 1) add schema fields and API response with `recommended_severity` and `impact_hint`, 2) telemetry events for apply lifecycle, 3) console mockups showing suggested severity and the metric that triggered it, 4) RFC for heuristics. I'll take RFC + telem PR.

julia: add read-only history view for oncall that highlights which metric tripped the page decision and the override chain. also ensure RBAC: only owners can override default severity for production rollouts.

matt: agree. also add a small safety: if owner overrides to lower severity than server recommends, require a grace period or a mandatory canary run with telemetry acknowledgments.

anya: :+1: this should cut noise and make pages meaningful.

sam: creating RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/config-apply-pager-policy-2026 — will link PRs here when I have them.

matt: nice. :thumbsup:

julia: thanks — looking forward to the mockups.
